source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "internet access" AND (inequality OR gap OR rural)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"internet access" AND (inequality OR gap OR rural),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("internet access" AND ("gap" OR "inequality" OR "rural"))
